workflowName: Social Media Effectiveness Tracker - Multi-platform Post Collection (Create)
description: Create this month's social-media tracking table in Bitable and import posts for Instagram, X, YouTube and Facebook via Apify.

input.description: No runtime input. Configure the Config node (Bitable app token, table id, Lark app ID/secret) after import.

output.description: Rows written to Bitable; see the last node for per-platform results.

executionId.description: Returned by n8n execute_workflow; poll get_execution for the result.
